snippet.title: Trading Card Inspector - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3723750/Trading_Card_Inspector/ Trading Card Inspector, releasing June 2026!

A "Cozy Job Simulator" for a job that doesn't (and shouldn't) exist! Start your new job as an official Habubis Trading Card Inspector and uncover a tale of friendship, corporate espionage and murder?!
